SoCG 2021 3.2 Monotonicity The first step in showing that V+α is a good filtered cover is to show that every Delaunay simplex in Dα appears and disappears at most once. There are two ways that a simplex can be removed at time α. First, it may be that its Voronoi cell becomes empty and therefore it is removed from the Delaunay triangulation entirely. This is the standard case to analyze in flip-based Delaunay computation. Second, it may be that only the clipped Voronoi cell becomes empty. In this case, we must show that it remains empty for the rest of the filtration.
